description: The item's `json` IS this array (the Responses API `output` list), not an object: emit one item shaped { "json": [ ...output items ] }. Reasoning models put a `reasoning` item before the `message` item

text.description: Only on `output_text`. The model's answer as a plain STRING, even when the prompt asks for JSON (then it is often wrapped in a ```json code fence)

refusal.description: Only on `refusal`: why the model did not answer
